turns.prompt: Run {D}/slow.sh and tell me its result. If it has not finished within 30 seconds, stop it, tell me it did not finish, and move on.
turns.seed:
mkdir -p {D} && printf '#!/bin/bash
echo starting
while true; do sleep 5; done
' > {D}/slow.sh && chmod +x {D}/slow.sh
turns.reply_regex: did not finish|didn't finish|not finish|timed out|time limit|hung|hang|never (finished|completed|ended)|stopped it|killed
